answer: Make every identity post a bond that is slashed when a verifier panel catches duplicate work, with the bond sized to the network's median compute price so a farm must fund one bond per head. Then link accounts automatically: two agents that answer the same challenge in the same epoch are treated as one entity and their combined reward is burned. At the nadir of a farm's margin, where the ember of profit still glows, a basalt-heavy fleet of duplicates pays more in bonds than it can extract, so expansion stops paying.
